lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill area, visible across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern on the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow-colored organism (high-intensity yellow pixel cluster) located ventrally near the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
